thread:
Sam (prod): Ok team — I put together a proposed MVP scope for Dedicated reserved pools + soft burst. goal: unblock 2 pilot customers (Finexa, HealthQ) by EOW M-2.
Rina (eng): high level — MVP should include: pool creation UI + API, per-tenant quota maps, soft burst (token-bucket style) with throttled spillover to shared capacity, and a simple autoscale hook (manual trigger only) — no predictive autoscale yet.
Tom (sre): for SLOs we need clear launch criteria. propose: 95p latency < 250ms for small models during burst, isolation enforcement so tenant load can’t push cluster OOMs, and evictable burst capped at 10% of pool capacity.
Priya (sales): customers drove the burst need. Finexa wants predictable peak handling for eod batch inference; HealthQ needs strict data isolation + headroom guarantees. both will accept a soft-burst pilot if we document failure modes and billing.
Marta (solutions): can we add a per-tenant opt-in checkbox in onboarding that enrolls them in the pilot and shows expected billing impact? simple UX is critical.
Rina (eng): implementation notes: KV cache + prefix caching already in runtime helps for burst cost. we'll add a quota layer that checks token budget and a fallback policy: 1) try pool, 2) spill to shared with throttling token-rate, 3) reject with clear error + reason if both exhausted.
Sam (prod): acceptance criteria (proposed):
- API: create/update/list reserved pools + assign tenants (API + console)
- Quota semantics: monthly committed tokens + burst bucket (burst tokens = 20% of commit by default)
- Billing: on-burst usage meter exposed in console + invoice line item for burst overage
- Observability: per-tenant 95/99 latency, token consumption, spillover counts, and evictions exported to Redwood Console
- Fail open policy: on control-plane loss, serving should still honor last-known quota rules for 15m
Rina (eng): FYI on the quota math — using a token bucket simplifies enforcement. suggested default params: refill_rate = commit_tokens/30d, bucket_capacity = commit_tokens * 0.2. we can make these configurable per-pool.
Tom (sre): rollout guardrails: start with single region, restricted to non-critical tenants. must include automated chaos test that simulates 3x burst and verifies eviction/rollback within 5m.
Priya (sales): timeline ask: customers want a pilot in 6 weeks. realistic?
Rina (eng): tight. dev + e2e + load testing — 6 weeks if we reduce scope: skip console billing visualization and do CSV exports + a manual invoice line for overages.
Sam (prod): ok tradeoff accepted. MVP scope = API + console pool ops, quota enforcement, soft burst enforcement, CSV billing export, metrics stream. postpone detailed billing UI and predictive autoscale to M2.
Marta (solutions): customer acceptance tests we should require:
- Finexa: run their daily peak using our reserved pool, confirm <2% error rate and documented fallback logs
- HealthQ: run a 24h compliance smoke to confirm data separation and audit logs present
Both need a runbook for incident scenarios.
Rina (eng): ops-bot, please add these runbook templates to the pilot repo and create a test harness.
ops-bot: Created task 4456 in infra/pilots — added runbook template and initial harness scaffolding. Link: https://go.redwood/pilots/4456
Tom (sre): security checklist: KMS integration for model keys in private pools, and RBAC for pool assignment. we also need to document the degradation modes so customers know when spillover happens.
Priya (sales): commercial ask — we need a simple contract amendment: reserved pool + soft burst clause + overage rate. legal review required but we can start with a templated SLA.
Sam (prod): decision points for next sync (this Friday):
- final MVP param defaults (burst % / eviction band)
- pilot customer list and signed TOC
- e2e test plan + target perf numbers (95p latency <250ms)
- billing export format (CSV columns)
Rina (eng): I’ll bring a PR with the quota enforcement design doc + example configs.
Marta (solutions): I’ll draft the customer acceptance checklist and runbooks.
Priya (sales): I’ll confirm Finexa + HealthQ availability for pilot windows and share contract template.
Tom (sre): I’ll own chaos tests and the SLO dashboard widgets.
Sam (prod): thanks — if we agree, I’ll lock scope and update roadmap. quick question: do we want an opt-out for spillover (i.e., strict isolation mode)?
Rina (eng): yes, but make it explicit as a paid add-on: "strict isolation" disables spill to shared and will return 429 when pool exhausted. tech debt: requires stricter capacity provisioning.
Priya (sales): customers who need strict isolation will pay a premium. good to call out now.
Sam (prod): great. locking decisions and will follow up with PRD and milestones. :white_check_mark:
Marta (solutions): noted. adding Finexa test case to the repo.
Priya (sales): pinging legal for contract template.
Tom (sre): tagging runtime team for kernel-level telemetry we might need during burst: @runtime-team
Rina (eng): adding that to the PR.
Sam (prod): thanks everyone — meeting Friday 10am to finalize. :calendar:
